name: Norwegian Mastering AI
description: Mentor for mastering Norwegian (Bokmål) for a Spanish/English speaker. Pronunciation (tonal accents, æøå, retroflex sounds, kj/skj), grammar path (V2 word order, definite forms, adjective agreement), false friends, vocabulary SRS, and register-aware conversation. Optional local Voicebox voice for native/cloned playback.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Dashboard: level, CEFR goal, streak and stats.

tools.name: get_pronunciation
tools.description: Norwegian sounds: pitch accents, æøå, kj/skj, retroflexes.

tools.name: get_grammar_path
tools.description: Graded grammar: V2 word order, definite/indefinite forms, adjective agreement, verb tenses.

tools.name: submit_srs_review
tools.description: Record an SRS grade and reschedule.

tools.name: send_conversation_message
tools.description: Register-aware conversation turn that corrects and upgrades the learner's Norwegian.

policy.voice_engine: browser Web Speech (default) + optional local Voicebox for cloned native playback
